data.name: Modern FPS Gun Strike
data.description_full:
Lock and load. Modern FPS Gun Strike puts you in the middle of intense combat missions where every firefight demands sharp shooting skills and tactical thinking. Play offline, anywhere, anytime, with no wi-fi required.

You are a commando operative dropped into hostile territory. Terrorist forces control the streets, the rooftops, and the corridors. Your job is to clear them out using a growing arsenal of real-world weapons across multiple action-packed shooting missions. This is not a run-and-gun arcade game. It is a first-person shooter built around cover, aim, and execution.

WHAT YOU GET

A full roster of fps action missions set across urban combat zones, open battlefields, and tight indoor strike environments. Each mission drops you into a new scenario with specific objectives, so no two runs feel the same.

Weapons that matter. Assault rifles, sniper rifles, shotguns, and sidearms, each with distinct handling and firepower. Pick the right weapon for the situation and your shooting skills will carry the day.

Tactical shooting gameplay. This is a modern shooter that rewards patience and positioning. Use cover, read enemy movement, and line up your shots. Spray and pray will get you killed.

Multiple combat modes to keep the fps shooting fresh. Work through the story-driven commando campaign or jump into standalone strike operations for a quicker session. The variety keeps the action engaging whether you have five minutes or an hour.

Progression that feels earned. As you complete missions and sharpen your shooting skills, new weapons and gear unlock. Every successful tactical strike against enemy forces pushes your loadout forward.

Smooth first-person controls optimised for touch screens. The fps action stays fluid and responsive so the gameplay never gets in the way of the combat.

Fully offline gameplay. No internet connection needed to run any mode. Download once and the entire commando shooter experience is yours to access whenever.

WHO THIS IS FOR

If you have played military action shooters and wanted a mobile version that respects the genre, this is it. Whether you are a seasoned fps combat veteran or stepping into a first-person shooter for the first time on mobile, the missions scale in intensity so the challenge grows with you.

Download Modern FPS Gun Strike now and step into the combat zone.
data.description_short: Tactical FPS combat missions. Real weapons, offline action, no limits.

data.name: Rosy Journey Crush
data.description_full:
🌹 Rosy Journey Crush: Every Match Takes You Somewhere Beautiful.​ 🌹
Pack your heart and set off on a dreamlike adventure. Rosy Journey Crushis a match-3 puzzle that blends travel wonder with romantic charm. Swap rose quartz tiles, lavender clouds, and amber sunsets as you journey through enchanted valleys, seaside villages, and moonlit gardens. Each level is a new destination — and every match writes a new chapter in your story.
Journey Highlights:
• Scenic Tile Art:​ Tiles are inspired by travel treasures — vintage postcards, pressed flowers, compass roses, and stained glass. The board changes theme as you progress through different regions.
• Exploration Progression:​ Start at the Rose Gate and travel through the Petal Plains, Coral Coast, Twilight Forest, and finally the Golden Castle. Unlock beautiful landmarks and panoramic views.
• Romantic Encounters:​ Along the way, meet friendly locals, charming guides, and perhaps a mysterious companion who leaves rose petals behind. Their stories unfold as you match.
• Wandering Soundtrack:​ A gentle acoustic guitar and violin melody, mixed with ambient nature sounds — birdsong, ocean waves, evening crickets. It feels like walking through a painting.
• Travel Keepsake Rewards:​ Collect souvenir stamps, miniature globes, handwritten diaries, and exclusive “Rose Compass” boosters that guide your matches with a soft glow.
Rosy Journey Crushis for wanderers at heart. It reminds us that the best journeys are the ones shared — even if it's just you and a trail of rose petals.
👉 Download now and start your rosy journey.
data.description_short: Every Match Takes You Somewhere Beautiful.​

data.name: My Little Village
data.description_full:
My Little Village — a Vietnamese village-building game in an idle simulation style. Build houses, expand your neighborhood, recruit residents, trade, and grow your very own rural community! A simulation game that captures the essence of traditional Vietnamese life, deeply filled with nostalgic childhood memories.

🏡 BUILD & EXPAND YOUR VILLAGE
Start from a few simple cottages, and step-by-step build and upgrade them into a bustling, lively neighborhood. Construct residential houses, street-corner tea stalls, rural markets, schools, medical clinics, and dozens of other community buildings. Each new structure unlocks new professions, daily life activities, and trading opportunities for the whole village. Plan, arrange, and decorate your neighborhood in your own unique style.

👫 RECRUIT & MANAGE RESIDENTS
Every resident in the village has their own distinct personality, dream job, and daily routine. Recruit new residents and match the right person to the right job — from the hard-working farmer in the field, the cheerful vendor at the rural market, to the highly skilled carpenter. Build close-knit neighborly relationships and watch your community grow stronger every day. Complete quests from residents to earn rewards and unlock new content.

🌾 ENJOY THE VIBE OF VIETNAMESE COUNTRYSIDE
Golden rice fields, water buffaloes lazily grazing, a shimmering fish pond in the afternoon, and the cheerful laughter of neighbors — a peaceful, tranquil atmosphere that brings you back to your most beautiful childhood memories. The traditional Vietnamese countryside setting is authentically recreated with a cute, bright, and familiar art style. Experience the beauty of folk culture, traditional crafts, bustling village markets, and vibrant village festivals.

⏰ IDLE - RELAXING CASUAL GAMEPLAY EVERY DAY
My Little Village is an idle game - gather resources automatically without needing to be online constantly or connected to the internet 24/7. Just open the game for a few minutes a day to manage your village, harvest resources, and feel the warm, little joys of life. Perfectly suited for busy people who want to unwind with a gentle, pressure-free, and non-competitive game - play at your own pace.

🎮 HIGHLIGHT FEATURES
• Build and upgrade dozens of traditional Vietnamese village structures
• Recruit residents with diverse personalities and professions
• Dynamic economic system: trading, manufacturing, and harvesting crops
• Complete quests and events to unlock brand new areas
• Cute graphics with a distinct Vietnamese art style
• Offline idle game: casual play, automatic resource collection
• Free to download, suitable for all ages
• Regular content updates with new events and residents

📲 Download MY LITTLE VILLAGE today — build your dream village, rediscover your childhood memories, and enjoy a peaceful life in our little neighborhood!

Developer: COROCHTI
Genre: Simulation | Idle | Village Building | Casual

data.name: 時尚百貨城
data.description_full:
《時尚百貨城》是一款超休閒的百貨經營手遊。每次逛街看到百貨商場裡琳瑯滿目的店鋪，是不是也會幻想自己當老闆的樣子？是不是常常跟閨蜜手牽手逛街，卻發現每家店都差不多，怎麼都找不到讓人眼睛一亮的那種店？來來來～在這裡，你真的可以當老闆，親手打造屬於自己的時尚百貨城！從一間小小的快餐店開始，用你獨到的經營腦袋，把商場裡那些快倒店的鋪子一間間救回來——讓冷清的服裝店變成網美打卡熱點，把積灰塵的玩具店改造成潮玩集散地！遊戲結合了店鋪經營、夥伴養成、時尚換裝、美美家裝⋯⋯玩法超豐富，讓你在輕鬆歡樂的氣氛裡，爽爽體驗擴張事業的激情，享受變成富婆的樂趣！

【自由經營，打造商業傳奇】
從小小快餐店起步，你的每一點努力都會讓你離「富婆夢」更近一步！開連鎖超市、高級服裝店、盲盒公仔城⋯⋯每種店都有不同的經營玩法，考驗你的腦力～隨著資金和經驗一直累積，你還能直接把整座商場買下來，把每一家店都變成爆紅名店，成為真正的商業大亨！

【百變時尚，定義專屬風格】
在時尚之都，你的形象就是你的招牌！超多套潮流時裝隨便你搭——休閒運動風、奢華晚禮服、街頭潮酷、甜美森林系，想換就換！還有自訂家裝玩法，不只打扮自己，還能打造屬於你的超狂豪宅！

【夥伴助手，助力經營擴張】
一個人的力氣有限，但有一支神團隊就能無敵啦～招募並培養各行各業的菁英——金牌銷售員、天才設計師、行銷專家⋯⋯他們都會變成你的最強幫手！還有機會簽約唱跳全能的偶像明星當代言人，讓你的品牌紅遍全城！

【休閒放鬆，享受富婆生活】
忙著經營之餘，也要記得享受生活喔～可以自由逛街補貨，或在自己的私人豪宅裡耍廢放空。遊戲是輕鬆的放置玩法，利用零碎時間就能輕鬆管理你的時尚百貨城，超讚的啦！

data.name: Pine Cone Ludo
data.description_full:
Most Ludo apps give you a board, four tokens, and a dice roll. Pine Cone Ludo gives you a world.

Pine Cone Ludo is built for players who want more than a casual pass-and-play experience. It combines classic Ludo rules with clan loyalty, ranked progression, fast Mini matches, deep customization, and features you will not find in a standard Ludo clone.

WHAT SETS PINE CONE LUDO APART

◆ TWO BOARDS, TWO EXPERIENCES
Most Ludo games offer one map and one pace. Pine Cone Ludo gives you Classic mode on a full 15×15 board with four pieces per player, and Mini mode on a compact 11×11 board with just two pieces — perfect when you want a quick, decisive match without losing depth.

◆ CLANS ARE PART OF THE GAME
Join ancient houses with their own symbols and colors, complete clan-only monthly quests, and climb clan leaderboards alongside your allies. Reach Master rank and seal your own clan — name, emblem, and color — then recruit members and lead your house to glory. Ludo becomes a team identity, not just a board.

◆ RANKED MASTERY, NOT JUST WINS
Every match builds your Seniority and Degree. Progress from newcomer to Master across a long-term profile that tracks your standing, clan rank, and reputation — giving every game a purpose beyond the final square.

◆ BLOCKADES THAT MEAN SOMETHING
Stack two of your pieces to form a blockade rivals cannot pass. Toggle the feature, set a custom blockade message, and hear it spoken when you lock down a lane. Combine blockades with starred safe zones for genuine strategic play — not just rolling and moving.

◆ YOUR VOICE ON THE BOARD
Set custom spoken messages for captures and blockades that play aloud when you make your move. It is celebration, warning, or intimidation — your call.

◆ A STORE WORTH PLAYING FOR
Spend earned Pinecones on dice skins, piece styles, board centers, home bases, and visual effects. Your board looks like yours, not a generic template shared by millions of downloads.

◆ QUESTS THAT KEEP YOU COMING BACK
Daily, weekly, and monthly challenges — plus exclusive clan missions — reward Pinecones and Seniority. Logging in, winning matches, and representing your clan all feed a live progression loop rare in board game apps.

◆ SOCIAL DEPTH ON YOUR PROFILE
Add friends by player ID, review detailed match history, share victories, and compete across leaderboard categories for wins, wealth, social standing, and clans.

◆ BUILT FOR A GLOBAL COMMUNITY
Available in multiple languages with a polished interface, readable in-game rules, and voice-supported guides.

HOW YOU CAN PLAY
• Pass-and-play on one device — 2, 3, or 4 players share one phone or tablet
• Solo mode — sharpen your skills whenever you have a few minutes
• Classic or Mini — pick the board that fits your mood

AUTHENTIC RULES, REFINED DELIVERY
• Roll a 6 to enter — three sixes in a row ends your turn
• Capture opponents and earn bonus rolls
• Safe zones protect your pieces; blockades stop everyone else
• Smooth animations, sound design, and modern board themes

If you have tried other Ludo apps and felt something was missing — the rivalry, the identity, the reason to come back tomorrow — Pine Cone Ludo is the answer.

Download now. Choose your clan. Claim your rank. Roll the dice.
data.description_short: More than Ludo: clans, Mini mode, blockades, custom dice & voice battle cries.

data.name: Bloom Sudoku
data.description_full:
Bloom Sudoku is a relaxing logic puzzle game with simple rules and smooth flower-placement gameplay.

Place flowers on the colorful grid and solve each puzzle with pure logic. Each color, row, and column can contain only one flower, and flowers cannot adjacent each other, even diagonally.

Tap a cell to mark it with X, or swipe across multiple cells to mark them quickly. When you are sure about a flower’s position, double-tap to place it.

Start with easy 4x4 puzzles and progress to larger, more challenging boards.

Features:

Simple Sudoku-style logic
Tap to mark X
Swipe to mark multiple Xs
Double-tap to place flowers
Color, row, and column rules
No-adjacent flower constraint
Clean and calm visual design

Bloom Sudoku is easy to learn, but every level gives your brain a fresh little challenge.

data.name: The Roman Conquest
data.description_full:
Rome is calling. Take command of the legions and lead the Republic to dominion over every province.

The Roman Conquest is a turn-based strategy game of territory control set in ancient Rome. March your centuries across the map, fortify your borders, manage your treasury, and crush your rivals in tactical dice battles. Easy to learn, hard to master, and completely offline.

If you love the classic board game of world domination — rolling dice to attack, reinforcing your front lines, and holding entire regions for bonus troops — you'll feel right at home. This is that timeless "conquer-the-map" experience, rebuilt from the ground up with a Roman soul and a fresh set of rules all its own.

⚔️ TACTICAL DICE COMBAT
Every battle is decided by the roll of the dice. Attackers commit up to three dice, defenders hold with two — or three behind fortifications. Win enough battles and your centuries become veterans, earning a re-roll when it matters most.

🗺️ TERRITORIES & PROVINCES
Claim territories one by one, but true power lies in controlling whole provinces for extra reinforcements each turn. Plan your expansion, choke your enemies, and turn the map red.

🎴 EVENT CARDS
Play a deck of powerful event cards — rain down javelins, form the testudo, win the favor of the Senate, spread plague, sabotage defenses, and more. Timing is everything.

🏛️ DEEP TURN STRUCTURE
Reinforce, collect income, play cards, attack, and maneuver your armies. A clean, deep phase system that rewards smart planning over luck alone.

🤖 SOLO OR ONLINE
Sharpen your tactics against a challenging AI — 100% offline, no connection required. Or take the fight online and battle other commanders for the provinces.

🛠️ BUILD YOUR OWN MAPS
Design and edit your own battle maps with the built-in editor. Every campaign can be different.

FEATURES
• Turn-based strategy of conquest and territory control
• Tactical dice battles with veterans and fortifications
• Province bonuses that reward bold expansion
• A full deck of event cards to turn the tide
• Single-player vs AI — 100% offline
• Online multiplayer battles
• Custom map editor
• Original rules, authentic Roman theme

Rally your legions, cross the Rubicon, and write your name in history. Rome was not conquered in a day — but the map is waiting.

Download The Roman Conquest and begin your campaign today.
data.description_short: Conquer every province in tactical dice battles — Roman turn-based strategy.

data.name: Zen Arrow: Tap Away Puzzle
data.description_full:
Want a relaxing puzzle that makes you think? 🍃 Zen Arrow combines satisfying tap away gameplay with thoughtful path planning and a soothing Zen atmosphere. Tap arrows, unblock paths, and clear the board one move at a time.

🎯 HOW TO PLAY

• Tap an arrow to move it in the direction it points.
• An arrow can move only when its path is clear.
• Plan the right order before you tap.
• Unblock paths by moving the right arrows first.
• Clear every arrow from the board to complete the level.
• Think ahead and find the most satisfying solution.

🧩 GAME HIGHLIGHTS

—Satisfying Tap Away Gameplay: Tap arrows, unblock paths, and clear tricky boards one move at a time.

—Arrow Path Puzzles: Follow each arrow's direction and plan the best sequence to clear the board.

—Relaxing Brain Teaser: Challenge your logic and spatial reasoning with calming puzzle gameplay.

—Stress-Free Fun: Take your time, study the board, and solve each puzzle at your own pace.

—Soothing Zen Atmosphere: Enjoy calming sounds, smooth animations, and peaceful visuals as you solve each puzzle.

—Thousands of Handcrafted Levels: Progress through a large collection of carefully designed puzzles with a gentle difficulty curve.

—Zen Art Collection: Solve puzzles and unlock peaceful art cards inspired by serene natural scenes.

🌿 A PEACEFUL ZEN PUZZLE BREAK

Slow down, clear your mind, and enjoy a relaxing Zen puzzle at your own pace. If you like tap away games, arrow puzzles, path puzzles, brain teasers, and logic games, Zen Arrow brings them together in a soothing Zen experience.

Ready to unwind? Tap, plan, and clear the board with Zen Arrow today!
data.description_short: Unblock arrow paths, clear the board and relax with a soothing Zen puzzle.

【ยุทธภพคืนชีพ｜สัมผัสโลกจอมยุทธ์สุดสมจริง】
ก้าวเข้าสู่โลกแห่งจอมยุทธ์อันกว้างใหญ่ ที่เต็มไปด้วยการต่อสู้และความแค้น สัมผัสบรรยากาศยุทธภพเต็มรูปแบบ และออกผจญภัยในโลกที่เสมือนจริงด้วยตัวคุณเอง!

【8 สำนักใหญ่｜ค้นหาสำนักที่เป็นของคุณ】
ง้อไบ๊ เทียนซาน สราญรมย์ เส้าหลิน บู๊ตึ๊ง กระยาจก เม้งก่า ดาวดึงส์...เลือกเข้าร่วม 1 ใน 8 สำนักระดับตำนาน พร้อมวิชาและรูปแบบการต่อสู้เฉพาะตัว เพื่อค้นหาเส้นทางยุทธภพของคุณ!

【พลิกตำนาน｜สานต่อเรื่องราวแห่งเทียนหลง】
พลิกชะตาของเฉียวฟง และร่วมท่องยุทธภพไปกับเหล่าตัวละครระดับตำนาน ท่ามกลางมรสุมที่กำลังจะอุบัติขึ้น... มาร่วมเปิดฉากมหากาพย์บทใหม่ในโลกเทียนหลงด้วยตัวคุณเอง!

【ร่วมสาบานพี่น้อง｜ตะลุยยุทธภพไปด้วยกัน】
พบปะพรรคพวกและยอดฝีมือจากทั่วทุกสารทิศ ร่วมทีมเผชิญหน้ากับความท้าทาย ต่อสู้เคียงบ่าเคียงไหล่และเติบโตไปด้วยกัน เพื่อจารึกตำนานบทใหม่ร่วมกัน!

【ศึกสำนักเดือด｜เปิดศึกชิงชัยเหนือยุทธภพ】
รวมพลสมาชิกพรรคตบเท้าเข้าสู่สงครามสำนักสุดเร้าใจ ท่ามกลางศึกชิงความเป็นหนึ่ง... จงใช้พลังและกลยุทธ์เหนือชั้นของคุณเพื่อพิชิตยุทธภพให้จงได้!

data.name: VectorArrow: Mini Maze
data.description_full: VectorArrow: Mini Maze is a minimalist, level-based puzzle game with no timer and no rush — only how you observe and reason matters. Each level is a compact space packed tight with arrows: short ones, long ones, pointing in every direction, forming a sharp geometric jungle. Your only move is to choose. Tap an arrow and it shoots straight away in the direction it points. The real challenge comes when removing one arrow clears a path for another, setting off a chain reaction that ripples through the entire puzzle. In that moment, the crowded maze seems to breathe and unwind on its own — that quiet, focused satisfaction is the heart of the game. Slow down, observe, tap. Make every direction count.
data.description_short: Solve the Arrows Maze.

EASY TO PLAY, SATISFYING TO MASTER
Aim your cannon, release to fire and enjoy the destruction. The controls are simple, but finding the perfect shot takes skill.

EXPLORE A PIRATE ISLAND WORLD
Travel through tropical beaches, mysterious ruins and dangerous pirate territories as you complete increasingly challenging levels.

SMASH EVERYTHING IN YOUR PATH
Break barrels, destroy crates, crack stone defences and bring entire structures crashing down with powerful cannon shots.

PLAN THE PERFECT SHOT
Adjust your aim and use the environment to create spectacular chain reactions. One well-placed cannonball could clear the entire level!

SATISFYING DESTRUCTION
Enjoy explosive impacts, collapsing structures and rewarding smash effects with every successful shot.

Load the cannon, take aim and begin your island-smashing adventure. Can you destroy every target and conquer all the islands?

data.name: 天天拼詞王
data.description_full:
《天天拼詞王》是一款結合了中國古典美學與文字拆解樂趣的休閒益智遊戲！在這裡，你需要打破對文字的固有認知，發揮極致的觀察力與想像力，從一個看似簡單的漢字中，找出隱藏在筆畫間的其他「常用字」。
🎮 遊戲特色
🧠 顛覆認知的文字解謎
「字中找字」的核心玩法，將漢字的部首與筆畫重新解構。每一個筆畫、每一個轉折都可能拼湊出全新的字意，一字拆出千萬意，徹底活化你的大腦思維！

📜 清新雅致的古典美學
遊戲採用溫暖的米色紙張背景與傳統的毛筆筆觸設計。在古色古香的視覺氛圍中，讓你一邊解謎、一邊享受沉浸式的靜心體驗。

🏆 海量關卡，成就感滿滿
從簡單的「小試牛刀」到充滿挑戰的「無懈可擊」，豐富的關卡設計讓你百玩不膩。成功通關還能獲得金幣獎勵與專屬成就評價，一步步成為真正的拼詞王者！

💡 貼心提示，不怕卡關
遇到找不到的字怎麼辦？別擔心！遊戲內建實用的「提示」功能，在你江郎才盡時助你一臂之力，輕鬆點破盲點。

適合什麼樣的你？
👉 喜歡文字遊戲、成語接龍或填字謎的玩家。
👉 想在通勤、休閒時間活動一下大腦的上班族與學生。
👉 想要培養觀察力，鍛煉腦力，重新認識漢字之美的各年齡層玩家。

現在就下載《天天拼詞王》，從一筆一畫中發掘驚喜，挑戰你的漢字極限吧！

Проходите сюжетную кампанию, участвуйте в испытаниях, исследуйте подземелья, побеждайте могущественных боссов и открывайте новые главы истории Шести Миров.

data.name: Grid Fit
data.description_full:
Looking for a quiet way to sharpen your mind and unwind? Welcome to Grid Fit. This is a gentle spatial logic puzzle where every block reacts to your moves with its own expressive face. Your objective is simple: drag out rectangles based on the numbers on the grid and find the exact space each emotion needs to feel balanced.
✨ Why You Will Love Grid Fit
• Expressive, Reactive Blocks: The grid is alive with feelings! As you drag to form shapes, the faces inside react in real time. Watch them show worry when cramped, surprise when stretched too far, or calm satisfaction when given the correct space.

• Mind Bending Challenges: Start with simple shapes and advance to massive brain teasers. As you progress, you will encounter tricky obstacles like hidden numbers (?) and locked tiles (🔒) that require clever strategies to solve.

• Calming, Focused Gameplay: Designed with clean visuals and minimal interruptions. Sink into a steady, relaxing flow state as you work through each level at your own pace.

• Helpful Boosters: Stuck on a super hard level? Use the lightbulb hint to instantly reveal the perfect fit for a stubborn block and keep the fun going.

•A Low Pressure Environment: There are no stressful timers or harsh penalties. Take your time to analyze the grid, follow the clues, and let the board puzzle together naturally.

💡 How to Play
• Give Each Emotion its Space: The number on each face indicates exactly how many grid squares its rectangle must cover.
• Drag to Fit: Swipe to stretch the block into a square or rectangle.
• Establish Boundaries: Each shape must contain exactly one expressive face, and territories cannot overlap.
• Solve the Puzzle: When the entire grid is correctly filled with the right sized shapes, the board clears and rewards you with a screen of fully satisfied, happy faces!

🧠 Benefits of Playing
• Interactive Logic: The changing micro expressions of the blocks make solving numeric grids intuitive and visually engaging.
• Gentle Brain Training: Quietly exercises your spatial reasoning and logical deduction skills without overwhelming your mind.
• Satisfying Order: Experience the quiet satisfaction of turning a scattered grid of numbers into an organized, harmonious board of perfectly balanced expressions.

Grid Fit is a straightforward logic puzzle built for quiet moments. Easy to learn yet offering a steady mental workout, it is a soothing way to spend a few minutes a day bringing order to a world of colorful emotions.
Download today and find your flow!

PupDoku — A Colorful Logic Puzzle for Dog Lovers

Love Sudoku, brain teasers, and adorable pups? PupDoku is a relaxing logic puzzle game where every move matters.

Your goal is simple: find the correct place for every hidden pup while following the puzzle rules. It is easy to learn, satisfying to solve, and challenging enough to keep your brain active.

Simple Rules, Clever Puzzles

Each puzzle board is divided into colorful zones. Use logic and careful observation to determine where every pup belongs.

• Place exactly one pup in every row.
• Place exactly one pup in every column.
• Each colored zone must contain exactly one pup.
• Pups cannot touch each other, even diagonally.

Mark the spaces where a pup cannot be placed, narrow down the possibilities, and solve the board step by step. There is no need for random guessing—every puzzle has a logical solution.

**Choose How You Play

**Level Mode**
Complete carefully designed puzzles and take on more challenging boards as you progress.

**Daily Challenge**
Return every day for a fresh puzzle and keep your logic-solving streak alive.

Jump straight into a random puzzle whenever you want a quick brain workout.

💡 **Stuck on a Puzzle?**

Use hints to discover the right move and continue solving without losing your progress. Hints are perfect for learning new strategies and overcoming difficult puzzles.

✨ **Why You’ll Love PupDoku**

• Relaxing and satisfying logic gameplay
• Cute pup-themed visuals
• Colorful puzzle boards

🧊 Cube Sort 3D – Match, Store, and Plan Your Way! 🧊

In this relaxing 3D puzzle, a colorful stack of cubes sits in the middle of your screen. Your goal? Pick out the right colored cubes and send them flying into matching storage boxes above. Each level shows you exactly which colors you need and how many – just tap a cube of that color, and it automatically zips into its box. Watch the numbers drop to zero, and you’re one step closer to winning!

🔍 See Every Angle
The cube pile is fully rotatable – spin it, zoom in, or zoom out to spot hidden colors. Long‑press to make cubes transparent, so you can peek inside the pile and find those tricky buried pieces. No rush – take your time to examine the structure from every side.

📦 The Storage Slot – Your Backup Plan
Below the target boxes, you’ll find a row of temporary storage slots. If you accidentally tap a cube whose color isn’t currently needed, it won’t disappear – it lands in a storage slot. Later, when that color becomes a target again, the stored cubes automatically jump into the right box and help you progress. But slots are limited, so don’t fill them with random colors!

🧠 Smart Strategy for Success
Always prioritize the current target color – this keeps your storage slots free for emergencies. Use rotation and zoom to spot the easiest cubes to reach first. For blocked areas, long‑press to see through and plan your next moves. The fewer cubes you store, the smoother your run. Plan your taps wisely, and every level becomes a satisfying, stress‑free victory.

data.name: Paint or Seek and Hide: Online
data.description_full:
Paint or Seek is a hide-and-seek action game where you can paint your character, blend into the environment, and avoid being discovered by Seekers. Play online with other players or enjoy the game offline in single-player mode without Wi-Fi. Choose your role, explore various maps, and use camouflage to hide in plain sight. Play as a Hider and blend into the environment like a chameleon, or become a Seeker and find every hidden player before the timer runs out.

PAINT YOUR CHARACTER AND HIDE
As a Hider, find the perfect hiding place and press the red Paint button to enter Paint Mode. Use the painting tools to change your character’s colors and match nearby walls, objects, patterns, and decorations. The better your camouflage, the harder it will be for Seekers to notice you. Hiding is not only about standing behind objects. Paint your character, become part of the map, and hide directly in front of your opponents.

USE AUTO PAINT
Use the Auto Paint button to quickly camouflage your character. Auto Paint uses the environment behind you to help your character match nearby colors and patterns. Stand in the right position, activate Auto Paint, and prepare your camouflage before the search begins. Choose your hiding place carefully, because even perfect camouflage will not help if a Seeker notices you moving.

PLAY PROP HUNT MODE
Discover Prop Hunt gameplay and use objects, decorations, walls, and other parts of the environment to your advantage. Find a clever hiding place, match your surroundings, and use camouflage to fool the Seekers. Stay hidden until the timer ends and prove that you have chosen the perfect spot.

PLAY AS A SEEKER
As a Seeker, your goal is to search the entire map and find all hidden players. Look carefully at walls, corners, objects, decorations, and unusual shapes. Hiders may be painted to match the environment and could be hiding directly in front of you. You have five minutes to find every Hider before the timer reaches zero.

SURVIVE AS A HIDER
As a Hider, you must remain hidden until the end of the match. Find a smart location, paint your character, stay quiet, and avoid attracting attention. Seekers will inspect every part of the map, so both positioning and camouflage are important. Survive until the countdown ends to win the round.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Join online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt matches with other players. Compete as a Hider or Seeker, discover new hiding strategies, and test whether your camouflage can fool real opponents. Play online with friends or join multiplayer matches with players from around the world.

OFFLINE SINGLE-PLAYER
No internet connection? Paint or Seek can also be played offline. Enjoy single-player gameplay without Wi-Fi, practice painting and camouflage, explore colorful maps, and play hide-and-seek against computer-controlled characters. Offline mode is perfect while traveling, when mobile data is unavailable, or whenever you want to play alone.

• Automatic camouflage with Auto Paint

Paint your character, match the environment, and hide in plain sight. Create the perfect camouflage and survive like a chameleon, or become a Seeker and find every hidden player before time runs out.

data.name: Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles
data.description_full:
Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles brings together two beloved formats: jigsaw-style picture assembly and tile-matching strategy. The result is a puzzle that feels both familiar and entirely new. If you enjoy jigsaw puzzles, solitaire puzzles, or block-style puzzles, this one belongs on your device.

What Makes This Puzzle Different?

Most jigsaw puzzles are static. You open a box, sort pieces, and work toward a fixed image. This puzzle flips that model. Instead of a flat board, you face a vertical grid where tiles fall from above. Merge matching tiles to complete sections of a picture. Each completed section clears, and new tiles drop in. The puzzle keeps evolving with every move.

This falling mechanic turns every session into a living puzzle. You are not just assembling — you are managing, anticipating, and adapting. It is a puzzle that rewards careful thought without punishing hesitation. No timers, no lives, no pressure. Just you and the puzzle.

🧠 How to Play This Puzzle

● Find the matching tiles, slide and merge them.
● Strategically move tiles on the board based on which pieces are about to drop next
● Complete all sections to finish the current jigsaw puzzle
● Experience the satisfying payoff of solving each puzzle from start to finish

❤️ WHY PLAY Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles?

This puzzle never repeats itself. The falling order changes every time, so no two puzzle sessions feel the same. Whether you have two minutes or two hours, you can jump into a puzzle and make real progress.

For solitaire puzzle fans, the strategy adds depth. You are not matching randomly. You decide which sections to complete first and how to let new tiles fall. It is a puzzle that asks you to think ahead.

For block puzzle players, space management feels instinctive. Keeping the board clear is half the battle. Every merge buys you room. It is a puzzle of balance and foresight.

💪 Puzzle Collection That Grows With You

This puzzle game offers a wide variety of scenes. Nature puzzles, animal puzzles, art puzzles, and abstract puzzles are all included. Each puzzle you complete unlocks the next, so there is always a new puzzle waiting.

Difficulty scales gradually. Early puzzles give more room and simpler patterns. Later puzzles tighten the grid. But the core puzzle mechanics stay the same, so you never feel lost — you just get better at solving each puzzle.

🔥 Key Features of This Puzzle Game

● Unique falling tile puzzle blending jigsaw and solitaire
● Hundreds of HD jigsaw puzzles across multiple themes
● No timers, no stress — every puzzle at your own speed
● Satisfying clears and smooth animations for each puzzle
● Daily puzzle updates to keep things fresh
● Block-puzzle style space management adds strategic depth
● Perfect for quick puzzle sessions or longer play
● Regular additions to the puzzle library
● Intuitive touch controls designed for mobile puzzle games

⭐ Start Your Puzzle Journey Today

Download Jigsaw Falls: Merge Tiles and find a puzzle that fits your lifestyle. Five-minute mental reset or longer focused solving — this puzzle delivers. Beautiful visuals, smooth mechanics, and a challenge that is always just right.

Download now and see why this puzzle is different!

연극처럼 펼쳐지는 3D 실시간 전략 RPG —

그리고 지금—
‘별이 선택한 자’인 당신이
이 모든 운명의 중심에 선다.

조합과 선택에 따라 전투와 전략이 완전히 달라진다.
각기 다른 개성과 능력을 지닌 캐릭터들을 모으고
당신만의 극단으로 최고의 무대를 완성하라!

▶ 부담 없이 즐기는 전투, 강렬한 쾌감
오프라인 성장으로 자원을 획득하고,
한 번의 터치로 강력한 필살기를 발동!
다양한 적과 보스에 도전하며 압도적인 전투 쾌감을 느껴라!

▶ 공연처럼 펼쳐지는 화려한 전투 장면
모든 전투가 하나의 공연처럼 펼쳐진다!
화려한 스킬과 강렬한 타격으로 전장의 피날레를 장식하라!

▶ 끝없이 확장되는 성장과 콘텐츠
다양한 콘텐츠와 성장 시스템이 끊임없이 이어진다!
플레이할수록 더 강해지고, 더 넓은 전장이 열린다.
풍성한 보상으로 빠른 성장을 체감하라!

▶ 마음을 움직이는 판타지 드라마
무대 밖에서 만나는 또 다른 그녀들의 모습.
함께하는 시간 속에서 쌓이는 감정과 이야기,
오직 당신만을 향한 특별한 순간을 경험하세요.

지금, 당신의 이야기로 무대를 완성하세요.

■ 스마트폰 앱 접근권한 안내
앱 이용 시 아래와 같은 서비스를 제공하기 위해 접근 권한을 요청하고 있습니다.
[필수적 접근권한]
-

저장공간: 사진 및 동영상 저장 및 업로드를 위해 필요합니다.
카메라 : 사진 및 동영상 촬영을 위해 필요합니다.

data.name: Bộ Lạc 3Q
data.description_full:
Bộ Lạc 3Q là một tựa game Tam Quốc chắc chắn sẽ làm dậy sóng cho cộng đồng game thủ tại Việt Nam, khi tái hiện thế giới quen thuộc theo phong cách nguyên thủy đầy mới lạ. Dàn thần tướng được tạo hình nhí nhố nhưng vẫn rất cá tính, khoác lên mình những bộ chầy khố độc đáo. Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm một tựa game giải trí độc nhất vô nhị, đây chính là ứng cử viên sáng giá.
⁕⁕⁕ TÍNH NĂNG ĐẶC SẮC⁕⁕⁕
1. Tam Quốc Đồ Đá – Đập Nhau Thấy Đã
Bộ Lạc 3Q quy tụ dàn danh tướng quen thuộc, nay được tái sinh trong hình hài nguyên thủy đầy mới mẻ. Không chỉ combat căng đét bằng những vũ khí được tạo bằng đá còn có các gậy gộc và cung nỏ đều được sử dụng để chiến đấu, kết hợp cùng đồ họa đẹp mắt mang đến cho người chơi trải nghiệm thích thú về một thế giới Tam Quốc bí ẩn.

2. Tặng 1000 Lượt Chiêu Mộ - Phúc Lợi Khổng Lồ
Mỗi ngày đăng nhập là được tặng nhẹ 1000 lượt chiêu mộ, say mê quay tướng thoải mái, không cần nghĩ nhiều. Cơ hội sở hữu những cái tên xịn sò như Gia Cát Lượng, Trương Phi trở nên dễ dàng hơn bao giờ hết với tỷ lệ ra tướng cực kỳ hấp dẫn. Dù là người chơi muốn cày chay, vẫn có thể thu thập được đủ các danh tướng cực mạnh, từ đó xây dựng đội hình ngon lành.
3. Tạo Hình Ngáo Ngơ – Chơi Vui Bất Ngờ
Hệ thống nhân vật được chia thành bốn phe Ngụy, Thục, Ngô và Quần Hùng, mỗi tướng đều có tạo hình và biểu cảm rất riêng, vừa sinh động vừa có chút ngáo ngơ duyên dáng. Từ những khoảnh khắc vui nhộn trong trận đấu đến phong cách chiến đấu khác biệt. Hãy chiêu mộ ngay và bố trí đội hình chiến đấu độc đáo, sẵn sàng đóng khố cầm chầy quẩy tung chiến trường.
4. Kỹ Năng Tấu Hài – Anh Tài Combat
Kỹ năng chiến đấu của các anh tài có một không hai, mỗi lần tung chiêu là một lần khiến người chơi bật cười. Mỗi danh tướng đảm nhận một vai trò rõ ràng: người mở đường cầm cung, kẻ bày mưu cầm quạt... phối hợp nhịp nhàng trong đội hình 5vs5, kết hợp tung chiêu nhanh nhẹn từ các anh tài, để tạo ra vô số màn combat rất riêng và không đụng hàng.

5. Xây Dựng Bộ Tộc – Cầm Gậy Gộc Quất Thiên Hạ
Tự tay xây dựng bộ tộc của riêng mình, và bắt đầu hành trình đánh đâu thắng đó. Từ những trận PvP liên server như Tranh Bá Cửu Châu căng thẳng, đến hoạt động PvE hào hứng. Vừa phát triển bộ tộc ngày càng mạnh, vừa chiến đấu với gậy gộc thôi cũng đủ tạo nên những trận chiến đáng nhớ.

data.name: Kanji: Japanese Word Search
data.description_full:
Kanji Search turns time with kanji into a puzzle you'll actually want to play — think classic Word Search, but with kanji.

Love Japanese, or learning it? It's a relaxing way to meet real kanji every day — and a satisfying brain-teaser if you just love puzzles.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every board gives you a set of target kanji and a grid of components. Swipe to connect the right pieces and complete each kanji — easy to pick up, satisfying to master. As you find one, you see its meaning and watch it drawn stroke by stroke, so you absorb real Japanese while you play.

WRITE IT, DON'T JUST FIND IT
Learn to write kanji — not just recognize them. Tap any kanji you've found to open the practice pad and trace it stroke by stroke over a guide, in the correct order and direction. Draw a stroke right in one clean pass and it locks in; miss and it resets — so the shape really sticks. Going from finding a word to writing it is where kanji start to feel like yours.

A QUICK EXAMPLE
森 "forest" = 木 + 木 + 木 (three trees). 休 "rest" = 亻 (person) + 木 (tree). Every kanji breaks into pieces like these — find them on the grid.

FOR ENTHUSIASTS & LEARNERS
• Real kanji with their meanings
• Stroke-by-stroke order for every kanji
• Spans JLPT levels, school grades, radicals and frequency

FOUR DIFFICULTIES
From breezy Easy boards to brain-bending Insane, there's a challenge for every level — whether you're prepping for the JLPT or just unwinding.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of kanji to discover
• Drag-to-find, word-search-style gameplay
• Trace-to-write practice — draw each kanji stroke by stroke, in order
• Meaning and stroke-order clue cards — toggle anytime
• Achievements and cloud save to track your progress
• Fully offline — no account, no internet needed
• Free to play, with an optional ad-free upgrade

Whether you're studying for the JLPT, brushing up your kanji, or simply after a calm, clever puzzle, Kanji Search makes every match a tiny lesson.

Download and start finding — and writing — kanji today.

Questions, ideas or bugs? Email us at kanji.search.en@rottzgames.com

data.name: RuneTalonr
data.description_full: RuneTalonr is a vertical casual tap-to-shoot mobile game. Its core gameplay revolves around high-speed flying crystal shard targets. Players need to accurately tap the targets to break them as they pass from both sides of the screen. Each successful break adds to your score. If a target flies off the screen without being hit, it counts as a miss. Once misses reach the limit, the current round ends. The game has a brisk rhythm and intuitive controls, testing both reaction speed and the ability to time your taps wisely when targets appear densely. From the main menu, you can start a new round or check the help section at any time. During a round, you can pause; the pause screen lets you continue, restart, or return to the main menu. The game-over screen shows your current round score and your all-time highest score, making it easy to keep challenging yourself to set new records. Overall, it is easy to pick up, offers short rounds with high feedback, and is great for playing in short spare moments.
data.description_short: RuneTalonr is a tap-to-shoot mobile game.

data.name: Siêu tiến hóa
data.description_full:
Trải nghiệm chiến đấu sống động! Tự do xây dựng Căn cứ Huấn luyện và Trung tâm Nghiên cứu Pokémon của bạn! Thám hiểm và truy đuổi trong tự nhiên, phục kích từ những bụi cỏ cao để giành chiến thắng bất ngờ, dễ dàng nâng cấp tài nguyên qua việc thu hồi tài nguyên và tối đa hóa phần thưởng của bạn với hệ thống quản lý tự động thông minh. Khám phá thế giới Pokémon và tiếp tục hành trình trở thành Bậc thầy!

【Công nghệ mô hình 3D cho trải nghiệm sống động】 Mỗi Pokémon được tái tạo tỉ mỉ qua mô hình 3D độ chính xác cao, từ vẻ ngoài đáng yêu của Pikachu đến sự hiện diện uy nghi của Charizard. Hiệu ứng kỹ năng độc quyền vô cùng ấn tượng, với những tia chớp và ngọn lửa rực cháy tạo nên trải nghiệm trực quan mạnh mẽ. Hơn nữa, các kỹ năng tương tác với môi trường trong thời gian thực—lửa trong cỏ, điện trên mặt nước—tạo nên trải nghiệm thực sự sống động!

【Sự lựa chọn của bạn định hình nên một hành trình độc đáo】 Pokémon không chỉ là lực lượng chiến đấu của bạn mà còn là người đồng hành cùng bạn trưởng thành. Sự tương tác sâu sắc và huấn luyện cá nhân hóa làm cho mỗi Pokémon trở nên độc đáo. Căn cứ, đội hình và chiến thuật của bạn cùng nhau viết nên câu chuyện Huấn luyện viên độc đáo của bạn.

【Lối chơi thông minh, trải nghiệm niềm vui qua chiến thuật】 Hãy tạm biệt việc chỉ tập trung tăng chỉ số một cách mù quáng! Hiểu rõ mối quan hệ giữa các thuộc tính, kỹ năng và đội hình; tận dụng môi trường và chiến lược để giành chiến thắng. Trong các thử thách PVE và trận chiến đấu trường, mỗi chiến thắng là minh chứng cho cả trí tuệ và sự gắn kết.

【Lối chơi xây dựng căn cứ: Tạo nên một ngôi nhà Pokémon ấm cúng】 Lối chơi xây dựng căn cứ SLG sáng tạo cho phép bạn tự do đặt các công trình như Trung tâm Hồi phục Pokémon và Vườn Cây Năng Lượng. Bố cục cân bằng giữa tính thẩm mỹ và hiệu quả; các sự kết hợp chiến lược giúp tăng tốc độ hồi phục của Pokémon và tăng tốc thu kinh nghiệm, cho phép bạn tạo ra căn cứ độc đáo của mình.

Thế giới đã sẵn sàng, câu chuyện đang chờ đợi sự khởi đầu. Giờ thì hãy ném Poké Ball và hét lên: Ta chọn ngươi!

data.name: Fortune Arrows: Tap Puzzle
data.description_full:
The arrows have been cast. The grid is set. Can you solve the sequence?
Fortune Arrows is a clean-design logic puzzle that challenges your spatial reasoning and planning skills. Forget luck—every puzzle is crafted with a guaranteed solution. Your goal is simple: clear the board by tapping arrows in the correct order. Watch as they fly off the grid in their pointed direction. But plan carefully: if an arrow's path is blocked by another, it won't move, and you'll lose a life. Clear them all without error to clear the board!

🏹 HOW TO PLAY
• Tap & Clear: Tap an arrow to launch it in its pointed direction.
• Path Rules: An arrow only moves if its flight path to the edge is completely clear of other arrows.
• Lives System: You start with 3 lives. Tapping a blocked arrow costs 1 life.
• Retry: Made a mistake? reset the level anytime.
• Objective: Remove every arrow from the grid to win.
✨ FEATURES
• Pure Logic: Zero timers and no hidden randomness. Rely on pure brainpower.
• 700+ Levels: Progress from gentle warm-ups to intense, mind-bending clusters.
• Helpful Hints: Stuck on a tricky layout? Use the hint system to reveal the next safe move.
• Clean Aesthetic: Enjoy meditative visuals with a unique arrow-inspired design.
Whether you have 2 minutes on your commute or want a deep brain-teasing session on the couch, Fortune Arrows delivers that "just one more level" feeling.
Read the arrows. Plan your sequence. Tap wisely.

data.name: Arrow Escape Go
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Escape Go!
Every arrow has a destination—but only the smartest players can set them free.
Arrow Escape Go is an addictive logic game where success depends on planning the correct sequence of moves. Each arrow points toward an exit, but neighboring arrows stand in the way. Carefully analyze the board, remove arrows in the right order, and clear every level with satisfying chain reactions.
Whether you're playing for a few minutes or diving into a longer puzzle session, every level offers a rewarding challenge.
How to Play
Each arrow points in a specific direction.
Tap an arrow only when its path is completely clear.
If another arrow blocks its way, it cannot leave the board.
Removing one arrow may unlock several others.
Continue clearing arrows until the board is completely empty.
Finish each stage to unlock more advanced puzzles with new layouts and mechanics.
Puzzle Mechanics
Every puzzle is built around careful observation and logical thinking.
Certain layouts require clearing outer arrows before reaching the center.
As difficulty increases, you'll encounter larger boards, more complicated arrow arrangements, and puzzles that require several moves of preparation.
Game Features
Hundreds of unique handcrafted puzzle levels.
Simple one-tap gameplay that's easy to learn.
Increasing difficulty that keeps every level fresh.
Relaxing visuals with satisfying clearing animations.
Strategic gameplay that rewards planning and patience.
Quick levels perfect for short breaks.
Tips for Success
Focus on arrows with completely open exits.
Think about how each move affects the remaining arrows.
Patience often leads to the simplest solution.
Why Play Arrow Escape Go?
Arrow Escape Go delivers a refreshing blend of logical thinking and satisfying gameplay.With intuitive controls, clean visuals, and endless handcrafted levels, Arrow Escape Go is the perfect game for anyone who enjoys casual puzzles with real depth.
Download Arrow Escape Go today and discover how many puzzles you can solve!

data.name: Color Sort Solitaire
data.description_full:
Color Sort Solitaire is a clean and engaging card game experience that combines color logic, visual sorting, and card-based strategy into a relaxing yet thoughtful puzzle. Designed for players who enjoy mind games, word games, logic puzzles, and wisely designed solitaire games, this experience turns colors into the core rule that drives every move while encouraging strategic thinking.

Each level presents a structured board filled with cards that may show numbers, letters, shapes, or objects. While their symbols vary — echoing the variety found in word puzzle and association-based games — every card follows one simple rule: color defines belonging.

Your task is to activate a color category and carefully guide each card to where it belongs. While the symbols on the cards may change, their visual identity remains the same. Mastery comes from observing the board, spotting connections, understanding how elements are associated, and thinking several moves ahead.

This is not a speed game. Every decision matters. Moves are limited, paths can block each other, and the board evolves as you play. The challenge grows from observation and foresight rather than memorization, offering a challenging yet rewarding experience inspired by the calm focus of a solstice moment.

🏆 How you win
- Correctly group all cards under their matching color categories
- Use your available moves efficiently and strategically

❌ When the game ends
- No valid color moves remain
- All moves are used before the board is cleared
Color Sort Solitaire is ideal for players looking for a calm but mentally engaging experience that blends visual logic with strategic thinking. Play at your own pace, enjoy the clarity of visual rules, and relax with a puzzle that stays thoughtful without becoming overwhelming. Fully playable offline, it’s a perfect choice for those moments when you want to focus — anywhere, anytime.

✨ Features
- Color-driven puzzle mechanics based on visual logic and clear connections
- Strategic, card-based gameplay inspired by classic solitaire systems
- Hundreds of carefully designed levels with increasing depth
- Relaxing pace with meaningful decisions in every move
- Free offline gameplay — no WiFi required
- Minimal, intuitive design suitable for all ages

If you enjoy logic puzzles, color sorting games, word puzzle mechanics, and solitaire-style strategy without pressure or timers, Color Sort Solitaire offers a refreshing and thoughtful take on casual puzzle and card game design.

Train your focus. Read the colors.
Download Color Sort Solitaire and master the logic of color.

data.name: Arrow Verse
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Verse!
Think carefully, tap wisely, and watch every arrow find its way out!Arrow Verse is a relaxing yet challenging logic game where every move changes the board. Your goal is simple: release every arrow by following its direction and clear the entire level.
With intuitive controls, colorful visuals, and hundreds of handcrafted stages,Arrow Verse delivers an addictive experience that keeps your brain active while remaining fun and relaxing.
How to Play
Tap an arrow to send it moving in the direction it faces.
An arrow can only leave the board if nothing blocks its path.
Removing one arrow creates new opportunities for others to escape.
Complete each level to unlock more difficult and creative puzzles.
Powerful Boosters
Stuck on a difficult level?
Hint highlights a removable arrow and points you toward the next correct move.
Game Features
Hundreds of carefully designed puzzle levels.
Simple one-tap controls that anyone can learn.
Increasing difficulty with unique board layouts.
Relaxing gameplay with satisfying arrow animations.
Strategic puzzles that improve logic and problem-solving skills.
Beautiful minimalist graphics with smooth visual effects.
No complicated rules—just pure puzzle-solving fun.
Offline support lets you play anytime and anywhere.
Suitable for players of all ages.
Tips for Success
Study the entire board before making your first move.
Always look for arrows with completely open paths.
Removing one arrow may unlock several others.
Avoid focusing on only one area of the board.
Why Play Arrow Verse?
Arrow Verse offers a satisfying blend of strategy, observation, and logical thinking. Whether you're looking for a relaxing casual game or a brain-training puzzle that keeps you engaged,Arrow Verse delivers endless entertainment through clever level design, smooth gameplay, and rewarding progression.
Download Arrow Verse today and see if you can clear every arrow and master every puzzle!

Võ Đài Liên Server – Bản Lĩnh Anh Tài
Đừng chỉ là kẻ mạnh nhất một phương! Hãy dấn thân vào những trận đấu rực lửa tại Võ Đài Liên Server, nơi quy tụ hàng ngàn cao thủ từ khắp đại lục. Những màn so trình kỹ năng mãn nhãn, những pha combo bùng nổ sẽ giúp bạn khẳng định vị thế độc tôn trên bảng xếp hạng Đại Lục.

Đoàn Chiến Liên Server – Sát Cánh Đồng Đội
Sức mạnh tập thể là chìa khóa của chiến thắng. Hợp sức cùng Đoàn Mạo Hiểm chinh phục hơn 10 hoạt động PvP đội nhóm liên server cực gắt:

Đấu Đội & Tranh Tài: Nơi chiến thuật và sự ăn ý lên ngôi.

Sau những giờ chinh chiến căng thẳng, hãy trở về với tổ ấm yên bình. Trải nghiệm cuộc sống ""nuôi cá và trồng thêm rau"", bổ củi, đào khoáng đầy thư thái. Đừng quên chăm sóc dàn Pet siêu cute để biến gia viên của bạn thành thiên đường nghỉ dưỡng đích thực.

Hẹn Ước Kết Duyên Liên Server
Thế giới rộng lớn, tìm thấy nhau là duyên, được bên nhau là phận. Hệ thống Kết Duyên Liên Server cho phép bạn tìm kiếm ""nửa kia"" dù ở bất kỳ đâu. Cùng nhau thực hiện nhiệm vụ cặp đôi, xây dựng tổ ấm và viết nên câu chuyện ngôn tình của riêng mình giữa Đại Lục huyền ảo.

data.name: Гиперион X
data.description_full:
Исследуй измененный мир Гиперион и открой для себя великие перемены! Жизнь никогда не станет прежней. Небо закрыл туман, звери обрели крылья, а города отодвинулись друг от друга… Отголоски древней войны настигли нас. Девять Звезд явили знак: настало время Великого созидания и героических битв.

Живи в мутировавшем мире, сражайся с межзвездными рыцарями и верни планете былое величие. Настал твой час войти в Гиперион!

- Герои

Выбирайте класс персонажа, а вместе с ним - боевой стиль, навыки и внешность.
Мечник — лучший танк в Галактике! Выбирай, если ценишь крепких ребят.
Ронин — живой ураган на поле боя Гипериона! Выбирай, если тебе нужен головокружительный крит.
Маг — молния в центре бури Гипериона! Выбирай, если хочешь парализовать врага и усилить союзников.
Лучник — тихая (или не очень) смерть с первого выстрела! Выбирай, чтобы враг умирал раньше, чем поймет почему.

- Экипировка

Множество вариантов оружия - красиво и смертоносно! Тебя ждут артефакты и камни души, крылья, святые мощи, тайное оружие и многое другое! Всё для ослабления противника и усиления себя любимого!

- Кастомизация на любой вкус

Одежда, не только красивая, но и увеличивающая твои параметры. Аватары, чтобы тебя никогда не перепутали с кем-то другим, и рамки для них. Облачка текста, звания, и много чего ещё.

- Всё для быстрого развития

Игровые механики на любой вкус - сражения с боссами и другими игроками, подземелья, битвы на арене, крафт, задания гильдий и даже парусная романтика. Одних только боссов не перечесть. Вас ждут сражения между игроками, а также битвы гильдий и даже целых серверов! Для дропа - рулетки и захватывающие ивенты, для приключений - мрачные подземелья, для созидания - мощный крафт, для коллекционеров - уникальный архив. Точно не соскучитесь!

- Воплощения

Выбирай Воплощения на высоких уровнях, чтобы стать ещё сильнее и сочетать способности разных классов в одном персонаже! С механикой воплощений лучник сможет почувствовать себя воином или даже магом. Головокружительные сочетания откроют новые возможности!
Также будут доступны два поистине непобедимых сабкласса (а ещё эти сабклассы невероятно красивы!)

- Невероятные ивенты

Расписание на неделю будет плотным! Банкет гильдии и работа в Шахте, подъем по этажам Обелиска и безжалостная война Афритов, ежедневная Арена и гильдейская Одиссея… Всего не перечислишь, но все сражения - за добро против зла.

- Новые знакомства

Объединяйтесь в кланы, общайтесь в личных сообщениях или общих чатах, найдите новых друзей и побеждайте врагов еще успешнее! Общие завоевания сплотят вас в межсерверных битвах, хранилище снаряжения позволит обменяться вещами, а гильдейские усиления сделают вас непобедимым. И, конечно, множество разнообразных активностей гильдии не даст заскучать!

- Многоуровневая система достижений и рейтингов

Ты никогда не устанешь развиваться и стремиться к цели!

- Прекрасная графика

Невероятный мир заворожит и не отпустит, заставляя вновь и вновь возвращаться!

До встречи в Гиперионе!

data.description_full:
여전사 키우기 — 내 손으로 만드는 최강의 여전사 군단

전사, 법사, 궁수.
세 가지 직업의 여전사들이 당신의 선택을 기다리고 있습니다.
누구를 키울지, 어떻게 조합할지는 오직 당신의 전략에 달렸습니다.

성장에는 끝이 없습니다 -
레벨업, 각성, 궁극기 해금.
강해졌다고 생각한 순간, 또 다른 성장의 길이 열립니다.
한계를 넘을 때마다 느껴지는 쾌감 — 이것이 여전사 키우기의 핵심입니다.

뽑는 맛이 있다 -
영웅, 장비, 스킬, 펫, 유물.
뽑을수록 확률이 올라가는 독자적인 레벨업 뽑기 시스템.
"한 번만 더"가 멈추지 않는 이유를 직접 경험해 보세요.

혼자서도 재밌고, 함께하면 더 재밌다 -
월드보스에 도전해 서버 최고 데미지를 기록하거나,
점령전에서 영역을 넓히며 시즌 랭킹에 이름을 올리세요.
길드원과 함께하는 레이드에서는
혼자서는 불가능했던 보상이 열립니다.

내 여전사 vs 너의 여전사 -
직접 구성한 덱으로 다른 플레이어에게 도전하는 영웅 PVP.
내가 키운 펫끼리 실력을 겨루는 펫 PVP.
시즌마다 갱신되는 티어,
상위권에는 남다른 보상이 기다립니다.

던전 하나하나가 다른 재미 -
골드가 쏟아지는 보물창고, 장비가 잠든 폐광산,
스킬의 비밀이 숨겨진 서고, 끝이 보이지 않는 무한의 탑까지.
오늘은 어디를 정복할지, 선택은 당신의 몫입니다.

매일 접속할 이유가 있다 -
패스 보상, 일일 던전, 시즌 랭킹.
하루하루 쌓이는 보상이
당신의 여전사를 더 강하게 만들어 줍니다.

data.name: 9a999
data.description_full:
9a999 is a fast-paced snake adventure for mobile. Guide a golden serpent across a grid, collect gold bars and rubies to grow longer, and chase a high score before hitting a wall or your own tail.

The app opens with a bold dark interface accented in gold and deep green. A sticky header, slide-out menu, and decorative banner set the tone for portrait play.

Navigation includes Play, About, Rules, and Rewards sections. The core game renders on a canvas grid with on-screen arrow controls and swipe support. Gold bars award ten points. Rubies award twenty-five points. Each item extends the snake length.

Wall collisions and self-collisions end the run. A game over overlay shows your final score. Your best score is saved locally. Restart instantly to beat your record.

About explains the treasure-collection snake concept with a feature illustration. Rules cover scoring values, collision penalties, and growth mechanics.

Rewards includes a rank system: Golden Master for two hundred or more points, Ruby Collector for one hundred or more, Bar Hunter for fifty or more, and Novice Explorer below fifty.

9a999 combines reflex-driven arcade gameplay, rising challenge, and a bold gold-and-green visual style in one compact app.

Collectible craft decorations
Clear puzzle stages to earn yarn coin rewards. Exchange coins for a wide range of craft ornaments and room decor items to customize your personal cozy craft space.
Full offline supported gameplay
The game runs smoothly without Wi-Fi or mobile data. Open and play during commutes, waiting periods or quiet indoor downtime to fill spare moments with light puzzle fun.
Regular fresh content updates
We launch new puzzle levels, limited seasonal craft decorations and new thread power-up mechanics periodically. Extra themed challenge stages will be added continuously to expand your matching puzzle options.
Visual & Game Experience
The game uses soft warm cartoon visuals with delicate yarn and fabric animation effects, delivering low-pressure, relaxing matching fun. Matching controls are simple to pick up for all players, ideal for casual daily entertainment.

data.name: Chameleon Game: Color Paint
data.description_full:
Chameleon Game: Color Paint is a relaxing color puzzle with one goal — paint to hide, and match the background so exactly that the Eye scans right past you.

Real chameleons are nature's painters, famous for changing color to hide in plain sight. That is your job here. Grab the color off the wall, paint the chameleon part by part, and fill the camouflage meter to green. Then vanish before the Eye looks.

🎨 GRAB THE EXACT COLOR
Tap a paint jar to pick a color, or hit GRAB to steal the exact shade straight off the wall — a perfect match, every time. Need something in between? Open the spectrum and tune hue, saturation and value until the color is right.

🦎 PAINT YOUR CHAMELEON
Swipe over your chameleon and paint each part to match the wall right behind it. Different parts, different colors. Keep tuning your chameleon color, then watch your chameleon hide into the background. This is coloring with a purpose: precision.

🔍 ZOOM IN TO CHECK
Not sure your green is THE green? Open the magnifier and compare your shade with the wall side by side. Tiny adjustments make the difference between close and perfect.

👁️ BEAT THE EYE
The Eye scans every hideout and rates your camouflage to the percent. Hit the target and you are HIDDEN; leave a bare spot and you are CAUGHT. Three difficulty tiers raise the bar from 80% to 90%, and the closer you paint, the more stars you keep. Some hideouts run against a countdown, so paint fast and paint right.

🎯 EVERY PART COUNTS
Your outline stays faintly visible the whole time, and a single unpainted patch gives you away. A perfect hiding place is always earned, never given.

🏆 TROPHIES & LEAGUES
Win trophies as your camouflage improves and climb the weekly leagues against other hiders. Only the top of each league promotes.

📅 A NEW HIDEOUT EVERY DAY
Today's hideout brings a fresh wall, a fresh palette, and a new color challenge. Clear it to keep your streak alive and bank the coins for a harder hide.

🖼️ HUNDREDS OF COLORFUL HIDEOUTS
Sunset Hills, Color Blocks, Study Desk, Pastel Pop, the Gallery — every themed pack brings a new background, a new palette, and a new way to hide. Every wall you clear becomes a painting you can hang in your gallery.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Tap the wall to study the color you need to match.
2. Grab a color, then paint the chameleon part by part.
3. Zoom in and compare the two shades.
4. Fill the meter, then vanish before the Eye finds you.

FEATURES
- Hundreds of handcrafted hideouts in colorful themed packs
- GRAB eyedropper — steal any color straight off the wall
- Full color picker: grid, spectrum and HSV sliders
- Camouflage scored to the percent: hide and paint your way to three stars
- Magnifier for close-up color matching
- Paint every part to match what is behind it — one bare patch and you are caught
- Trophies and weekly leagues against other hiders
- A new daily hideout, streaks and coins
- Single-player stealth puzzle — one wall, one perfect shade
- Optional in-app purchases: coin packs and remove ads

Whether you want a five-minute unwind or a precision color challenge for the evening, this chameleon game is easy to learn and hard to put down. Be the chameleon, paint to hide, and let the background swallow you whole.

Love relaxing chameleon paint puzzles? Make a chameleon, paint to hide, and clear your first hideout today.

- Destroy Descending Blocks: Blocks descend row by row. Use quick reflexes and precise aiming to clear your path.

data.name: 我要當學霸
data.description_full:
你是精通中文的文字達人嗎？《我要當學霸》將徹底顛覆你對漢字的刻板印象！這是一款將古典水墨美學與文字拆解謎題完美融合的全新益智手遊。在這裡，每一個漢字都是一座神祕的迷宮，等待你用極致的觀察力與想像力，看穿筆畫間的玄機，挖掘出隱藏其中的「字中字」！

🎮 核心遊戲特色
思維翻轉｜字裡尋字的解謎震撼
打破傳統「看字讀音」的習慣！核心玩法聚焦於漢字的「解構與重組」，一橫一豎、一撇一捺之間都暗藏玄機。一個看似平凡的字，竟然能拆解出十幾個全新漢字？絕對讓你直呼過癮，徹底活化大腦神經！

視覺盛宴｜沉浸式的東方古典美學
遊戲畫面採用宣紙質感的溫潤底色，搭配蒼勁有力的毛筆筆觸，宛如在宣紙上親手揮毫。伴隨古典雅致的背景音樂，讓你在燒腦解謎的同時，也能享受片刻的靜心與解壓。

百變關卡｜從新手入門到大師境界
海量關卡由淺入深，難度層層遞進。無論是放鬆心情的「小試身手」，還是令人抓破腦袋的「終極考驗」，豐富的題庫讓你百玩不膩。每成功破解一字，就能累積金幣並解鎖專屬成就，榮登拼詞王座！

靈光一閃｜絕不卡關的智慧提示
卡關、山窮水盡時該怎麼辦？別慌！遊戲內置貼心的「神機妙算」提示功能，隨時為你點破盲點、指引迷津，讓遊戲體驗流暢不中斷。

👥 誰最適合這款遊戲？
文字狂熱者： 鍾愛成語接龍、填字遊戲、解謎謎題的你。
腦力充電族： 想在通勤、午休等碎片時間活動大腦、遠離無聊的上班族與學生。
美學愛好者： 想換個方式重新領略漢字線條之美、提升觀察力的各年齡層玩家。

一筆一畫皆是驚喜，一字一心自成世界。漢字解構美學，挑戰你的眼力與腦力極限!
現在就下載《我要當學霸》，開啟你的文字尋寶之旅，成為真正的漢字大師！

data.name: Titanite: Mecha Survival Game
data.description_full:
Titanite is a post-apocalyptic Mecha survival game that fuses free-form building with competitive PvP action. In a world where rust and steel collide, you'll command powerful Mechas, carve your own path between the deadly Warzone and the absolute safety of your Base World, and forge your own rules of survival through strategy and gunfire!

♦ Battle and Tame Mechas ♦
Rogue Mechas once ruled the wilds, but now we fight back. Override their systems, seize control, and upgrade them into powerful war machines. From heavy siege units to agile fliers and resource harvesting rigs, each Mecha brings unique power to your fight for survival. Industrial types turbocharge your gathering, mobility units let you blaze across the wasteland at breakneck speed, and combat Mechas bring devastating firepower to suppress enemies and demolish fortifications. In a world shaped by steel and chaos, those who command the Mechas will rise.
♦ Two Worlds, Your Move ♦
Our revolutionary Dual-World system splits survival into two distinct realities. Drop into the Warzone where high-risk PvP means high-reward loot—take down rival survivors and steal everything they carry, but one death costs you the whole haul. Then teleport your spoils back to your Base World, a completely safe zone where you trade on the open market, upgrade your gear, and plan your next run. Risk it all for the big score or grind safe and steady? Your strategy, your survival.

♦ Explore, Build, and Defend Your Legacy ♦
Construct your base anywhere in your Base World, fortify it with walls and defensive turrets, and store your hard-earned loot. But survival isn't just about defense—team up with friends to design everything from a crude shelter to a sprawling steel fortress with automated defenses. Your base is your kingdom. Build it smart, or watch it burn.

♦ Dominate with Advanced Firearms and Tactical Combat ♦
Combat in the wild isn't just about firepower—it's about how you move, react, and strike. Combine unique firearms with tactical jetpacks for true three-dimensional warfare: hover above the chaos, dash through enemy fire, and deploy instant cover mid-fight for seamless attack and defense. Choose from a vast arsenal of weapons, each with distinct handling, attachments, and even unique abilities. Some high-tier guns come with built-in tech skills that can turn the tide of battle in an instant. With deep team tactics and high-skill mechanics, every firefight is a test of reflexes and coordination. Skill sets your ceiling. Teamwork seals the win.

data.name: Skyborne Survival

Step into a gentle world of order and clarity. Every level presents a small grid filled with directional markers, each pointing up, down, left, or right. Your mission is to release them all—one thoughtful tap at a time—until nothing remains but an empty board.

How to play:

Study the layout. A marker can leave the grid only if the route in front of it is completely open—no other piece may block its way.

Tap a free-moving marker to send it off the board. That single action opens new space and changes the whole puzzle.

If you tap a blocked marker, you lose one of your limited chances per level. But don’t worry—you can always reset and approach the puzzle from a fresh angle.

Not sure what to do next? Activate a hint, and the game will quietly point out a safe move.

Plan your sequence wisely, clear every marker, and feel the quiet satisfaction when the final piece disappears.

data.name: Destroy Shot
data.description_full:
Welcome to Destroy Shot. The cannon is your instrument, the arena your canvas, and every shot paints a picture of pure, unrelenting chaos. This isn't a game about careful nudges and gentle taps. This is about finding the one shot that tears through everything in its path. Every object in the arena — every jar, every crate, every stone fortress — is waiting for its final moment. Your job is simple: aim, fire, and erase it from existence.
What Makes Destroy Shot Special:
- The Art of Absolute Destruction Most games ask you to build or collect. Destroy Shot asks you to unmake. Each level presents a carefully constructed setup, and your job is simple in concept but deeply satisfying in practice: find the critical point and tear it all down. The physics engine ensures that every collision, every shatter, every collapse feels weighty and real. When you pull the trigger, the world responds with the full force of simulated destruction. There's nothing quite like watching a fortress crumble under the force of your single, perfectly aimed shot.
- Where Destruction Meets Celebration The arena is a festival turned spectacle. Colorful bunting stretches across crumbling walls. Lanterns sway as shockwaves ripple through the scene. The chaos is framed by celebration, making every explosion feel like a firework and every collapse feel like confetti falling. This is not violence for its own sake — it is destruction as theater, as performance, as the ultimate show.
- Precision That Rewards Mastery The controls are simple: aim, adjust power, fire. But mastering them is a journey. Understanding how different materials behave under impact, how objects interact in a chain, and how to read a setup for its critical weakness — this is the skill that separates a good shot from a legendary one. Every level teaches you something new, and every success feels earned.
Destroy Shot is for you if:
• You dream of the single perfect shot that changes everything.
• You find satisfaction in absolute, uncompromising destruction.
• You appreciate physics that feels real and weighty.
• You want a game that rewards precision but celebrates power.
• You believe that one well-placed shot is worth a hundred random ones.
Load the Cannon. Take Aim. Fire. Every level is a new setup waiting to be destroyed. Every shot is a new discovery. The arena is waiting for its grand finale — and you are the only one who can deliver it.
data.description_short: One shot to rule them all. Aim true, fire with intent, watch worlds fall.

data.name: Sultan's Game
data.description_full:
Play the first 30 turns for free. Unlock full version if you like the game. Sultan’s Game features complete content with UI and controls optimized for mobile devices.

2025's narrative strategy hit lands on mobile—uncut and optimized. A game of power, deceit, and deadly choices lies in your hands.

Inspired by One Thousand and One Nights, Sultan's Game is a narrative-driven survival card RPG set in an exotic court where deadly wagers, moral choices, and resource strategy collide in a tense, ever-shifting battle of wit and will.

The Sultan, capricious and cruel, has devised a deadly game. As his minister, every card you draw must be fulfilled within seven days. Fail... and you lose your head. Indulgence, luxury, conquest, murder... each card embodies a dangerous desire, a ticking death sentence that also grants the freedom to act without consequence. Will you commit forbidden acts in its name... or cling to your principles in the face of ruin? In a court warped by power and human weakness, you must shape your own destiny with wisdom and foresight as your tools.

There are no simple answers here, and every choice reshapes the story. Will you rise as the Sultan's favored confidant, or plot his assassination in the shadows? Will you remain loyal to love in desperate times, or surrender to forbidden desire? Will you stand tall as a fearless adventurer, or heed the whispers of dark gods? The game does not reward reckless indulgence—extreme cruelty breeds extreme hatred, and extreme consequences. Remember well, only those who hold fast to their own code can truly master their fate.

As a turn-based resource management game, you'll deploy cards to command allies and assets, complete objectives, and build your power, accumulating wealth, intelligence, and equipment as you go. Recruit allies, expand your influence, and seize control—every run is different, with card order reshaping each playthrough, while both success and failure unlock new allies, gear, and strategies.

Multiple endings await, each shaped by the choices you make. Will you seize absolute power, or rise to overthrow a tyrant? Will you retreat into a peaceful life with your beloved, or summon dark forces to bring the world to its knees? Even the same ending can be reached in countless ways, with hidden paths and secrets lying in wait for those bold enough to uncover them. Step forward... and let the game begin.
data.description_short: A story-driven strategic survival card RPG

Исследование и пейзажи
В игре вас ждут десятки уникальных точек для рыбалки — от уединённых природных уголков до оживлённых городских набережных. Открывайте новые места, любуйтесь красивыми видами и находите идеальные точки для поимки трофейной рыбы.
Стратегия и вызовы
Чем сложнее рыба — тем ценнее награда. Комбинируйте и улучшайте удилища, катушки и приманки, подбирая снаряжение под разные водоёмы и виды рыб. Соревнуйтесь с игроками со всего мира, доказывайте своё мастерство и выигрывайте ценные призы.
Строительство и отдых
За полученные награды вы сможете обустроить собственное уютное пространство: начните с простых украшений и постепенно превратите его в роскошный дом у воды. data.name: Lucky Arrow Path
data.description_full:
Lucky Arrow Path is a clean, thoughtful puzzle game built around a simple idea: every arrow knows where it wants to go.

Each level presents a board filled with arrows pointing in different directions — left, right, up, or down. Tap an arrow, and it moves one step in the direction it faces. Keep tapping, and it keeps moving until it reaches the edge and exits the board.

The goal? Send every arrow off the board.

But there is a catch. Arrows cannot occupy the same space. If two arrows cross paths or land on the same tile, you lose a chance.

The board starts simple but gradually introduces more arrows and tighter layouts. You will need to plan your moves carefully — which arrow to move first, which path to clear for the next.

Ready to guide every arrow home? Download Lucky Arrow Path and start your journey.

data.name: Quizovore - Quiz français
data.description_full:
Quizovore, les quiz qu’on dévore !

Quizovore est un jeu de quiz français avec 10 000 questions de culture générale, une progression complète et des cartes à collectionner pour découvrir de nouvelles images.

Répondez aux questions, améliorez vos scores, débloquez des niveaux et complétez progressivement votre collection, sans chronomètre ni limite de vies.

APPRENEZ EN JOUANT

Testez vos connaissances avec des milliers de questions variées réparties dans de nombreux thèmes :

• Animaux
• Astronomie
• Bonbons
• Cuisine
etc...

Choisissez entre les difficultés facile, moyenne et difficile.

Chaque question est accompagnée d’une explication pour vous aider à comprendre la bonne réponse et à enrichir vos connaissances.

PROGRESSEZ À VOTRE RYTHME

Chaque bonne réponse augmente votre progression générale et votre score dans le thème joué.

Débloquez progressivement une galerie de 50 niveaux, visualisez vos récompenses et partagez vos passages de niveau avec vos amis et vos proches.

Vous pouvez suivre :

• votre score général ;
• votre score dans chaque thème ;
• votre niveau actuel ;
• les prochains niveaux à débloquer ;
• les cartes gagnées pendant votre session.

COLLECTIONNEZ DES CARTES

Les bonnes réponses permettent de gagner des cartes et des doublons.

Chaque image de collection est divisée en plusieurs cartes. En obtenant de nouvelles cartes, vous révélez progressivement les différentes parties de l’image.

Quizovore vous indique clairement :

• les thèmes contenant de nouvelles cartes ;
• les images contenant des cartes non consultées ;
• le nombre de cartes gagnées pendant la session ;
• votre progression sur chaque image.

Naviguez librement afin de parcourir rapidement toutes vos nouvelles cartes.

UTILISEZ VOS DOUBLONS

Les doublons gagnés sont conservés dans votre coffre.

Vous pouvez les échanger contre des cartes Or afin de compléter plus l’image de votre choix.

De nouvelles animations accompagnent les gains de cartes, les découvertes, les échanges et la complétion des images.

DÉCOUVREZ DES IMAGES COMPLÈTES

Lorsqu’une collection est terminée, l’image entière est révélée.

Retrouvez toutes vos images complétées dans un espace dédié et parcourez-les grâce au diaporama.

JOUEZ COMME VOUS LE SOUHAITEZ

• Mode général pour varier les questions
• Quiz par thème
• Trois niveaux de difficulté
• 10 000 questions en français
• Explication après chaque réponse
• Progression générale et par thème
• Galerie de 50 niveaux
• Cartes à collectionner
• Images à découvrir progressivement
• Diaporama des images terminées
• Mode Révision pour rejouer les questions
• Partage des passages de niveau
• Progression sauvegardée sur votre appareil
• Aucun compte nécessaire
• Aucune inscription
• Aucune limite de vies
• Aucun chronomètre
• Aucun bonus payant

UNE EXPÉRIENCE SIMPLE ET SANS PRESSION

Quizovore vous laisse le temps de réfléchir. Aucun chronomètre ne vous oblige à répondre rapidement et aucune limite de vies ne bloque votre partie.

Votre progression est sauvegardée directement sur votre appareil. Vous pouvez jouer quelques minutes ou enchaîner les quiz pour améliorer vos scores, débloquer de nouveaux niveaux et agrandir votre collection.

Les publicités se limitent à une petite bannière discrète, sans publicité en plein écran.

Quizovore s’adresse à tous ceux qui aiment les quiz français, la culture générale, les jeux de questions-réponses, la progression, les collections et les défis accessibles.

Téléchargez Quizovore maintenant et commencez votre premier quiz.

data.name: Football Master 2: ЧМ 2026
data.description_full:
Выбор более 10 миллионов игроков — футбольная стратегия с максимально полным лицензированным контентом. В игре собраны легендарные звёзды, а победа зависит от тактического мышления и футбольного интеллекта!

【Разнообразн ый геймплей, доступны короткие игровые сессии — никакого гринда!】
Неважно, спокойный коллекционер, хардкорный стратег или любитель PvP-сражений — здесь каждый найдёт свой футбол!
Кубковый режим — основной игровой режим! Также доступны: карьерный режим — собери команду с нуля и пройди путь к чемпионскому титулу; рейтинговый режим — сражайся с игроками со всего мира за лидерство в таблице; режим альянсов — выходи на поле и побеждай вместе с союзниками; одиночные PvE-режимы — развивай команду и получай ресурсы даже офлайн.
Временные события воссоздают классические моменты футбольной истории — снова переживи те самые моменты, ставшие частью футбольной ДНК.
Забудь о постоянном ручном управлении — автоматический режим матчей освобождает от рутины. Всего несколько минут в день — и все ключевые задачи выполнены. Заходи в игру в любое время, даже в самый загруженный день!

【Стратегия решает исход — побеждай без ручного управления!】
Создано командой профессиональных разработчиков спортивных игр — футбол от настоящих фанатов и для настоящих фанатов! Расстановка, тактика, время замен и розыгрыш стандартов полностью под твоим контролем. Детально настраивай свой тактический стиль — каждое решение влияет на ход матча. Не нужно оттачивать сложные навыки управления: новичку легко начать, но за этой доступностью скрывается колоссальная стратегическая глубина, позволяющая по-настоящему «побеждать в чемпионатах за счёт футбольного IQ». Проект создан для тех, кто обладает глубоким футбольным пониманием и хочет испытать азарт тактического противостояния.

【Полная система развития — чем дольше играешь, тем насыщеннее становится игра!】
Прокачка игроков, повышение ранга, спецтренировки, развитие тренерского штаба, тактические нововведения и клубная инфраструктура — здесь есть все. Глубокая и разнообразная система развития открывает широкие возможности для роста и экспериментов. Освой её тонкости и повувствуй глубину долгосрочного управления клубом. Наблюдай, как перспективный новичок шаг за шагом превращается в звезду уровня «Золотого мяча», а чувство достижения просто зашкаливает!

【Графика матчей, не уступающая прямой трансляции. Полное погружение!】
Высокодетализированная 3D-графика выводит реализм на новый уровень: телосложение игроков, фирменные движения, текстуры формы и газона — всё проработано до мелочей. Ведь именно безупречное качество определяет игровой опыт! Динамическая смена ракурсов и эффектные замедленные повторы голов создают ощущение присутствия на трансляции матча. Футбольная страсть и накал борьбы буквально захлестывают с головой!

【Официальные лицензии топ-клубов — даже завершившие карьеру легенды доступны в коллекции. Максимально полный лицензированный контент!】
Официальные лицензии топ-клубов и максимально полный лицензированный контент — забудь о сожалениях из-за завершения карьеры любимых звёзд и удовлетвори свою страсть к коллекционированию. Лучшие версии действующих суперзвёзд и легендарных мастеров прошлого полностью собраны в игре. Огромное количество реальных эмблем, классических комплектов формы — собирай коллекцию без ограничений и создавай собственную команду мечты!

【Понимаем футбол — понимаем тебя. Доводим игровой опыт до совершенства!】
Мы понимаем любовь к футболу и потребности в развлечениях. Поэтому постоянно улучшаем продукт, опираясь на принципы «без гринда, стратегия прежде всего, полный лицензированный контент». Никаких лишних механик — только удовольствие от футбола, легко вписывающееся в повседневную жизнь.
Команда проекта собрала и учла более 10 000 предложений игроков и внесла тысячи улучшений, чтобы игра максимально соответствовала ожиданиям тех, кто по-настоящему разбирается в футболе.

Официальный сайт：http://cc.galasports.com/

data.name: RayBar Ac
data.description_full: RayBar Ac is a portrait-mode endless-run mobile game. Its core mechanic involves controlling a sleek gliding body to dodge left and right within a constantly descending void channel. Players slide left or right to adjust position precisely, weaving through gaps between energy guardrails and diamond-shaped crystal barriers. Higher scores make the channel scroll faster, shortening reaction windows. Colliding with a barrier ends the run, and you can challenge your all-time high score. The controls are intuitive, the pace intensifies step by step, making it suitable for short sessions and repeated attempts to push the distance limit.
data.description_short: RayBar Ac is an endless-run mobile game.

data.name: Munch Farm: Match Merge

Rather than focusing on decoration alone, the game turns your farm into a playful matching challenge. Every tap asks you to read the layout, choose the right order, and group the same crops together so the board keeps opening up. As stages shift and new arrangements appear, the calm countryside mood stays intact while the puzzle flow keeps things engaging.
Sunny fields, cheerful produce, and easy-to-read visuals make the whole experience feel welcoming from the start. As you continue, you will also see extra rewards, earnings displays, and progress-based surprises that give each successful clear a stronger sense of momentum.
(Note: These rewards and earnings displays are generated through gameplay and do not represent real-money gambling.)
Munch Farm: Match Merge blends farm charm with satisfying match-and-sort gameplay for a puzzle journey that feels fresh, lively, and rewarding.
This game is intended for entertainment only and does not offer real-money gambling, cash redemption, or real-world prize payouts. All rewards, earnings displays, and progression elements are generated through gameplay and remain subject to applicable terms and conditions. Players must be 18 or older. Begin with a small crew and grow your influence by taking over territories, managing operations, and engaging in intense turf wars.
