data.name: Tile Hole Master
data.description_full:
Tile Hole Master is a structured tile puzzle where you control a moving hole to swallow tiles and clear the board. Each level presents a carefully arranged tile layout that requires precise movement, smart positioning, and strategic board clearing.
In Tile Hole Master, the goal is simple: move the hole across the board and collect all tiles. However, each tile puzzle introduces different formations, stacked tile clusters, compact tile grids, and layered tile layouts that change how you approach the board. You must plan your path to avoid blocking future movement while clearing every tile.
Core Tile Hole Gameplay
• Drag to move the hole freely across the board
• Swallow tiles by positioning the hole correctly
• Clear all tiles to complete the level
• Avoid bombs and blocked zones
• Use boosters to manage dense tile formations
• Progress through increasingly structured tile boards
The tile hole mechanic focuses on movement precision and spatial awareness. Because tiles are arranged in structured formations, clearing one area too quickly may limit access to other tile groups. Careful path planning becomes essential as tile layouts grow more complex.

Tile Puzzle Design
Tile Hole Master is built around tile collection and board clearing strategy. Each tile puzzle level introduces different board shapes and tile arrangements. Some boards feature compact tile stacks. Others include layered tile blocks that require gradual clearing.
The puzzle design emphasizes tile grouping and tile flow. Understanding how tiles connect and how the hole moves across the surface is key to solving each stage. Tile collect strategy becomes more important as levels increase in density and obstacle placement.

Themed Tile Collections
Throughout progression, the tile visuals evolve into themed tile worlds while maintaining the same tile hole mechanic. The themes change the appearance of the tiles but preserve the structured tile puzzle gameplay.
Each theme introduces a fresh tile environment while keeping the tile collect and board clear objective consistent. The themed tiles create visual variety without changing the core hole puzzle structure.

Mahjong-Style Tile Layouts
Some levels feature mahjong-style tile layouts, inspired by structured tile stacks and patterned tile formations. These mahjong-style tile boards focus on arrangement awareness and board clearing order.
While Tile Hole Master is not a traditional mahjong match game, the visual tile structures may resemble mahjong tile stacks. The gameplay remains centered on moving the hole, swallowing tiles, and clearing the board.
Obstacles and Boosters: As tile boards become denser, additional elements appear:
Boosters help manage complex tile formations by supporting tile clearing in crowded areas. Strategic use of boosters can assist in finishing structured tile layouts.

Strategic Board Clearing
Tile Hole Master focuses on:
• Tile movement strategy
• Board awareness
• Spatial puzzle solving
• Tile grouping efficiency
• Structured board clearing
Each tile hole puzzle requires analyzing the tile layout before making large movements. Efficient tile collection prevents the hole from getting trapped by remaining tile blocks.

3D Tile Interaction
The 3D environment enhances tile depth and tile stacking visibility. You move the hole around elevated tile blocks, dense tile clusters, and layered tile formations. This adds dimension to the tile puzzle experience while preserving the core tile collect mechanic.

Tile Hole Master combines:
tile hole gameplay, tile puzzle structure, tile collect strategy, 3D tile boards, mahjong-style layouts, and evolving tile themes.
Every level centers on tile clearing, controlled movement, and structured puzzle design. Progress through themed tile worlds, refine your tile strategy, and clear each board by mastering the tile hole mechanic.

data.name: Yarnation: Unravel Flow
data.description_full:
Unravel the Threads. Complete the Pattern. Feel the Flow.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a relaxing yet deeply engaging sorting puzzle game where you unravel beautifully knitted artwork using colorful yarn bobbins. Instead of blasting or matching tiles, you carefully remove stitches in the correct order to clear each woven design piece by piece.

Every level feels like solving a handcrafted knitting puzzle.
Every move shapes the flow.
Every unravel delivers a satisfying visual payoff.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, color sorting challenges, flow puzzles, and calm strategy-based gameplay, Yarnation: Unravel Flow offers a smooth and rewarding experience that keeps your mind active while staying relaxing.

🧶 A UNIQUE YARN PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Bobbins move along a conveyor system and collect stitches of their own color.
Each bobbin has a limited capacity that decreases as it gathers matching yarn stitches.

When a bobbin’s capacity reaches zero, it disappears.
If capacity remains, it returns to the rack, ready to be reused later.

This simple yet clever system creates a satisfying puzzle loop where:

• Color selection matters
• Order matters
• Planning matters
• Capacity management matters

Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right sequence.

🧠 STRATEGY OVER SPEED

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is not about frantic tapping.
It’s about smart decisions and smooth sequencing.

As you advance through the levels:

• Patterns become more layered and detailed
• Colors overlap and intertwine
• Rack space becomes limited
• Managing your moves becomes more important

You’ll need to analyze the layout carefully, think a few steps ahead, and maintain a clean unravel flow without blocking yourself.

It’s a logic puzzle at heart — calm, thoughtful, and deeply satisfying.

🎨 COZY KNITTED AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a warm and visually charming yarn world featuring:

• Soft knitted textures
• Handcrafted pixel-style artwork
• Clean and colorful stitch patterns
• Smooth unravel animations
• Clear visual feedback

Watching a detailed knitted image slowly unravel into completion creates a uniquely relaxing puzzle experience.

🔁 PROGRESSIVE PUZZLE DEPTH

With hundreds of handcrafted levels, Yarnation: Unravel Flow introduces new challenges throughout progression:

• Fresh stitch arrangements
• New color combinations
• Deeper sequencing logic
• Smarter rack usage

The difficulty curve remains smooth and accessible while offering enough depth to keep puzzle lovers engaged.

🎮 SIMPLE CONTROLS, DEEP GAMEPLAY

The one-tap control system keeps the experience intuitive and easy to learn.

But beneath that simplicity lies a strategy puzzle built around:

• Color sorting
• Flow management
• Capacity control
• Smart sequencing

Easy to start.
Satisfying to master.

READY TO UNRAVEL?

Pull the right thread.
Plan your sequence.
Complete every knitted pattern with precision.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a fresh take on sorting puzzles — calm, strategic, visually satisfying, and beautifully woven.

data.description_full:
Listen closely and decide together - WHO IS THE IMPOSTER?

The Imposter game is built around one simple mechanic: most players know the secret word, and one does not. In every round of this imposter party word game, each person gives an association. One player must fake it and try to blend in.

The group talks, debates, and tries to find the impostor before it’s too late. Someone may confidently guess the imposter, while others wait and analyze who is the spy.


HOW TO PLAY
- See the word — or fake it if you didn’t.
- Give a clue.
- Discuss who is suspicious.
- Vote to find the impostor.

This imposter party word game is a hidden liar game, where subtle lying and careful listening decide the outcome. Players constantly try to find out who is lying, then they may challenge each other to explain their hints. When the discussion peaks, everyone will vote to guess the imposter.
In every imposter game, you must observe reactions and help the group find the impostor. Sometimes you immediately know who is the imposter; other times you hesitate, wondering who is lying while someone tries to fake it again!


Social deduction made simple: read people, think fast, and have fun!
Inspired by familiar unmask the spy game formats, this gameplay focuses on conversation and deduction—read behavior, control the situation and find who is the spy, or stay undercover and don't reveal yourself while guessing!

Listen carefully, analyze hints, and unmask the secret role. Each round challenges you to uncover the truth, even when someone stays completely under cover. Soon the room fills with questions: who imposter was acting strange? Who is lying about their clue? And finally — Who is the imposter?

PERFECT FOR GROUPS
It’s a simple game to play with friends! This flexible party game belongs in every collection of fun games to play with friends—it works as a quick group game during gatherings, trips or night parties. It fits naturally, it's easy to start, and matches other classic fun party games.
You can launch an imposter game anywhere and begin an imposter party word game session in seconds. Whether you’re hosting a casual party game night or organizing spontaneous fun games to play with friends, the format keeps everyone involved.

Play again and fake it better. Listen closer. And find the impostor! In every imposter game, someone must stay undercover, others will guess the imposter, and then must decide who is the spy.

Every room in this escape house hides secrets — locked doors, hidden objects, and dark corners where Granny could be waiting. The haunted house layout changes the way you think about every step you take.

👂 Sound-Driven AI That Punishes Noise
Granny doesn't rely on sight alone. She tracks sound. Drop something, run across a squeaky floor, or slam a door — and the scary grandma will come. Realistic 3D audio makes you feel every threat before you see it.

🔐 Multi-Layer Puzzle Escape System
This isn't a simple grandma escape room. Cracking your way out requires finding and combining items, decoding clues, and unlocking a chain of exits — each one harder than the last. Five distinct escape routes mean no two playthroughs are identical.

👥 Multiplayer Horror Mode
Team up or go head-to-head in multiplayer horror game sessions. Coordinate with a partner to distract the scary grandma while the other solves puzzles — or compete to see who survives longest inside the granny house. Multiplayer horror games with a grandma antagonist hit differently when the threat is this relentless.

🧠 Strategic Hiding Mechanics
Slide under beds. Press into closets. Hold your breath while Granny's footsteps pass inches away. The horror survival tension isn't just in the jump scares — it's in the seconds of silence before she decides to move on.

🎮 Controls Built for Tension, Not Frustration
Intuitive movement and interaction controls keep the focus on the fear, not the interface. New players can learn in minutes; surviving more than a day or two takes genuine skill and strategy.

📈 Progressive Difficulty
Each day inside the scary granny house tightens the screws. Granny moves faster, searches more thoroughly, and leaves fewer safe hiding spots. Reach day 5 and you'll understand why so few players ever walk out the front door.

data.name: Stickman Sandbox World
data.description_full:
Stickman Sandbox World is a side-scrolling action game featuring the classic stick figure character. It offers a fun and engaging gameplay experience that combines skill and strategy. Focusing on the core theme of "comeback," players control a seemingly weak stick figure character, defeating enemies, unlocking skills, and upgrading equipment to gradually overcome obstacles and become a powerful force. The game is well-suited for the fragmented gaming experience prevalent on WeChat. The simple vector art style combined with smooth combat feedback makes every battle exhilarating. It offers easy-to-learn controls for beginners and in-depth combo strategies for experienced players. Stickman Sandbox World eschews complex storylines, focusing instead on fast-paced battles and level progression. Diverse level designs, unique character unlocks, and competitive modes make this game stand out from its competitors, making it a great choice for casual gaming. Each level is a journey of overcoming adversity to become powerful, using simple controls to tell a thrilling story of triumph.

Stickman Sandbox World Game Features

1. A minimalist art style combined with impactful combat: Stickman characters feature clean lines yet fluid movements. Attacks and skill releases are accompanied by unique particle effects. The stark contrast between the impactful punches and kicks of normal attacks and the wide-area explosions of special moves creates an immersive combat experience.

2. Diverse characters and skill system: Players can unlock three types of stickman characters: melee, ranged, and support. Each character possesses unique skills, which can be upgraded to unlock advanced effects. Combine different equipment to create your own unique comeback build.

Stickman Sandbox World Basic Gameplay Introduction

1. Controls use a virtual joystick + skill buttons. The joystick controls the stickman's movement and dodging, while the skill buttons correspond to normal attacks and two unique skills. Holding down a skill button charges up and releases a powerful effect, optimized for one-handed operation on mobile devices.

2. The core objective is character growth and level progression. Players earn coins and materials by clearing levels to upgrade character levels, unlock skills, and enhance equipment, gradually overcoming initial weaknesses to achieve a power comeback. 3. The levels incorporate interactive elements. Some scenes contain destructible obstacles and hidden supply points. Making good use of scene resources can reduce the difficulty of battles, helping you to successfully turn the tide and pass the levels, increasing the fun and strategy of the gameplay.

data.name: A GO: Clear All Pointers
data.description_full:
A GO, a new logic puzzle game designed to sharpen your brain and test your precision. Your goal is straightforward yet satisfying: tap away the pointers to clear the screen, but there is a catch—these pointers only fly in one direction. You must assess the board, plan your sequence, and ensure every piece has a clear path to exit.

Navigating this vector maze requires more than just random tapping; it demands critical thinking and strategy. You need to find the correct angle to help each vector escape the grid without colliding with others. As you progress, the puzzle games evolve from simple warm-ups into complex IQ tests that truly challenge your spatial awareness and problem-solving skills.

Whether you are looking for a satisfying brain training session or a stress-free way to pass the time, this tap game fits the bill perfectly. With no timers to rush you, you can freely plan every move in this pure block puzzle experience. Master the logic behind the chaos, solve the jam, and ensure every arrowheads finds its way freedom.

🎮 How to Play:
• Tap the Arrowheads: Click any arrowheads to send it flying off the screen.
• Watch the Direction: Vectors only move where the arrowhead points.
• Clear the Path: Plan your moves so arrowhead lines don't collide.
• Solve the Maze: Clear the entire grid to win!

⭐ Key Features:

🧠 Smart Logic Mechanics
Don't just tap—think! The board is a tangled grid of directional pointers. If you tap the wrong pointer, it might hit another line and bounce back. Finding the perfect order to clear the maze feels incredibly rewarding.

🏆 Levels That Grow With You
Start with easy grids to learn the ropes, then advance to intricate levels featuring millions of variations. The difficulty curves naturally, keeping the game accessible for beginners while offering deep challenges for puzzle veterans.

🎨 Minimalist & Satisfying Art
Enjoy a clean, colorful interface that is easy on the eyes. The smooth animations as arrowheads zoom off the screen provide a satisfying ASMR-like experience. It’s the perfect visual escape from a busy day.

🚫 No Stress, Just Play
Forget about ticking clocks or punishment for mistakes. A GO is designed for relaxation. Take your time, analyze the puzzle board, and restart the level whenever you want to try a new strategy.

🌍 Play Offline Anytime
No Wi-Fi? No problem. A GO is optimized for on-the-go play. Whether you are on a commute, traveling, or just relaxing at home, your brain workout is always ready.

🧩 Why play A GO?
• Boost your IQ and spatial thinking.
• Satisfying "Tap Away" gameplay mechanics.
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels to solve.
• Perfect balance of relaxation and challenge.

Can you untangle the mess and clear every single arrowhead? Download A GO now and start tapping your way to victory!

data.description_full:
1. Game Rules
The core gameplay of Flower Power: The Art of Blooming revolves around matching and clearing tiles with identical patterns. Below the playing field, there is a slot that can hold up to 7 tiles. Clicking on a tile automatically places it into this slot. When 3 tiles with the same pattern are in the slot, they will be instantly cleared.

- Tip: You have a maximum of 7 moves per round to clear three tiles of the same design! If the slot fills up without matching three tiles, you lose. Every move counts!

- Layered Tiles: Some tiles may have multiple layers. Only after removing the top layer can you select and clear the lower layers.

- Winning Condition: Once no tiles remain on the board, you have successfully completed the level!

data.name: Obelisk: Home Horror Game
data.description_full:
Obelisk: Home Horror Game is an analog horror game and survival horror game inspired by The Obelisk Analog Horror. Enter a distorted home where fear feels personal, the walls feel alive, and every room pulls you deeper into a nightmare shaped by VHS horror, psychological terror, and maze-like dread.

This is not just another scary house. This is home, your hallway, your bedroom door, your familiar rooms twisted into a living trap by analog horror logic. Lights buzz like a dying CRT. Audio bends into a low mechanical hum. Static tears across the screen. The house changes when you are not looking, and somewhere inside it, The Obelisk is watching.

In The Obelisk: Home Horror Game, the core nightmare is simple: escape a place that refuses to let you leave. Rooms connect the wrong way. Corridors loop back with something subtly changed. Doors open into spaces that should not exist. A staircase leads farther down than your house should ever allow. What begins as a familiar environment becomes a cruel, shifting prison of fear.

Fans of The Obelisk Analog Horror, creepypasta horror, VHS horror, and psychological horror games will recognize the oppressive dread of stories like House with No Windows, Why Do You Keep Us Here, The Man in the Tower, and I Made a New Friend. This game turns that feeling into an interactive nightmare where the horror is intimate, distorted, and always close.

This is survival horror without power fantasy. You cannot become a hero. You cannot overpower what hunts you. You cannot fight The Obelisk. Your only tools are observation, timing, silence, and instinct. Listen for movement that does not match your own. Watch for details that shift. Learn the house before it learns you.

If you love analog horror games, scary games, VHS horror aesthetics, and dark exploration inside a cursed house, The Obelisk: Home Horror Game delivers a tense and immersive descent into fear. The deeper you go, the less your home feels like home, and the more it feels like something built to keep you inside forever.

You cannot reason with the house.
You cannot fight The Obelisk.
You can only survive long enough to understand what it wants.

And if you are wrong, the house will keep you.

The Obelisk: Home Horror Game is a terrifying analog horror experience for players who want survival horror, VHS horror, and a nightmare built from familiar spaces turned hostile.
